Workspaces

One app. Four points of view.

Each role signs into its own workspace with its own sidebar, accent colour and dashboard. Access is enforced in the main process — not just hidden in the interface.

Admin workspace

Run the whole school.

Every record, every rupee and every result in one command centre, with live dashboards, user management and a complete audit trail.

  • School-wide dashboard with attendance and finance trends
  • Students, staff, classes, subjects and academic sessions
  • Fees, payroll, exams, timetable, notices and reports
Office workspace

Keep the front office moving.

Admissions, fee collection, staff attendance, payroll and printable reports — the day-to-day desk work without the paperwork.

  • Admissions and student records with Excel import and export
  • Fee vouchers, receipts, defaulters and collection reports
  • Staff attendance, salary runs and school-wide reports
Teacher workspace

Teach, mark, done.

A workspace scoped to the classes a teacher actually holds — attendance, marks entry, timetable, leave and payslips.

  • Mark today's register for assigned classes only
  • Enter marks for own subjects; everything else is read-only
  • Personal timetable, attendance, leave balance and salary slips
Student workspace

Everything in one place.

A simple, private view of attendance, results, fees and the weekly timetable — only ever the student's own data.

  • Attendance calendar and monthly percentage
  • Published results with printable report cards
  • Fee status, receipts and a personal timetable
Features

Everything the office does, without the paper.

Ten connected modules share one database. A payment updates the ledger, a mark updates the result and an approved leave updates the payroll.

Student lifecycle

Admissions, guardians, photos, class and section, status changes, bulk promotion, Excel import and export, PDF lists and printable ID cards — all from one student record.

Auto admission numbersExcel importID cardsBulk promotion

Attendance

Daily registers, monthly percentages, present / absent / leave / late states, threshold reports and CSV export.

Fees & receipts

Fee heads, concessions, monthly vouchers, part payments, late fines, defaulter lists and sequential receipts.

Payroll

Salary structures, attendance-driven deductions, advances, one-click payroll and printable payslips.

Exams & results

Draft-to-locked exams, paper lists, marks grids, computed grades, positions and report cards.

Timetable

Periods, weekly grids, class and teacher views, with substitution-friendly clash warnings.

Reports & live dashboards

Every role gets its own scoped dashboard. Enrolment, attendance, fee collection, payroll and results can be printed as landscape PDFs that match the screen exactly.

Role-scoped dataLive chartsPrint-ready PDF

Notices

Audience-targeted announcements with pinning, expiry and a read-only view for the right roles.

Backup & audit

Daily automatic backups, reversible restore and an append-only log of every action.

English + Urdu

A complete bilingual interface with full right-to-left layout and bundled Nastaliq type.

Security & architecture

A server-grade spine inside a desktop app.

The renderer is treated as untrusted. The main process owns the database, checks every request and records what happened.

RendererReact · no Node
PreloadFixed API
MainRules + audit
SQLiteOne file
Electron 38 React 19 Vite 8 SQLite Tailwind CSS 4 Recharts i18next better-sqlite3
The renderer cannot touch the database.No Node, no filesystem, no SQLite handle — only the fixed API exposed by preload.
Every request is re-checked in main.Session, role and forced-password state are verified before an IPC channel runs.
Every action leaves a trace.bcrypt passwords, account lockouts, soft deletes and an append-only audit log.

Quick startWindows

Run it locally in two commands.

You need Node.js 20 or newer. The app is fully offline at runtime — the internet is only used to install dependencies.

powershell 
$ npm install
# rebuilds better-sqlite3 for Electron
$ npm run dev
# opens the app with hot reload
Node.js 20+ Windows 10/11 x64 No database server
